rules: Agents queue asks here instead of pinging the user. The daily digest shows at most 3, ranked by FOCUS.md and data/me/model.md. Unused asks expire after 48 h (state 'expired', not 'dropped'). Fields: id, created, expires, agent, ask, focus_item, focus_quote, kind (conversation|deadline|draft|todo|other), deadline, state (queued|shown|used|expired|declined).
